column1: # Held-out synthetic speech for vocabulary rescoring (GitHub #12670).
# SYNTHETIC: espeak-ng 1.52.0.1 (nixpkgs), formant synthesis, never a person's
# voice; scored apart from human speech. Written before any rescoring ran and
# separate from the #12665 sentences. Each line is spoken by en-us and
# en-gb-scotland. ID<TAB>the spoken words (also the reference)<TAB>terms=...
# (normalized words checked for recall) or distractor (no term: any change
# rescoring makes is a false replacement).
